title_ru: WHAT IS LOVE? v1.6 — Моногамия как устойчивость селективного предпочтения при повторении

scope_boundary.claim: This metric operationalizes one measurable dimension of love-like preference: persistence of a voluntarily selected target under repeated exposure and available alternatives.
scope_boundary.canonical_distinction: LOVE may contain repetition-stable selective preference; repetition-stable selective preference alone is not sufficient to prove LOVE.

operator.name: MONOGAMOUS_REPETITION_STABILITY
operator.human_readable_ru: Чем дольше субъект при свободе выбора добровольно возвращается к одному и тому же объекту или человеку, не демонстрируя устойчивого роста отвращения, скуки или систематического стремления заменить цель, тем выше устойчивость селективного предпочтения.
operator.monogamy_interpretation: MONOGAMY here means stable recurrent selection of one focal target across repeated choice opportunities; it is a measurement geometry, not ownership of the target.

V.name: voluntariness
V.definition: Fraction of repetitions that were freely chosen rather than caused by lack of alternatives, coercion, obligation, dependence or forced availability.

R.name: repeat_choice_rate
R.definition: Probability of selecting the same focal target again when a genuine choice opportunity exists.

S.name: satiation_resistance
S.definition: Resistance to progressive boredom, aversion or hedonic collapse across repeated exposures.

D.name: displacement_resistance
D.definition: Degree to which available alternatives fail to systematically displace the focal target.

T.name: temporal_persistence
T.definition: Stability of the preference across time windows rather than only within a short novelty burst.

Q.name: return_after_pause
Q.definition: Probability that preference for the focal target survives a meaningful period without exposure and reappears voluntarily afterward.

measurement_model.reasoning: Voluntariness is multiplicative because repetition without meaningful freedom of choice cannot be interpreted as evidence of selective attachment. Repetition and resistance to satiation receive the greatest weights because they directly encode the proposed criterion.

minimum_observation_rule.rule: Do not assign a strong-love interpretation from a single burst, isolated statement or one short observation window.

scale.label: NO_STABLE_PREFERENCE
scale.interpretation_ru: Повторение объясняется доступностью, привычкой, необходимостью либо быстро нарастающим насыщением; критерий любви не поддержан.

scale.label: TRANSIENT_OR_WEAK_PREFERENCE
scale.interpretation_ru: Есть предпочтение, но оно нестабильно либо легко вытесняется альтернативами.

scale.label: STABLE_AFFINITY
scale.interpretation_ru: Устойчивая симпатия или привычно выбираемая цель; слова «люблю» уже правдоподобны в бытовом смысле, но сильный критерий ещё не закрыт.

scale.label: DURABLE_SELECTIVE_ATTACHMENT
scale.interpretation_ru: Предпочтение выдерживает повторение, время и наличие альтернатив; сильное свидетельство устойчивой селективной привязанности.

scale.label: HIGH_REPETITION_STABILITY
scale.interpretation_ru: Очень высокая устойчивость добровольного повторного выбора без выраженного насыщения и систематического стремления к замене; критерий MRS закрыт.

positive_pattern: макароны выбираются снова в большом числе независимых возможностей выбора
удовольствие не демонстрирует устойчивого нисходящего тренда к отвращению
наличие других блюд не превращает прежнее предпочтение в случайность
выбор не вызван только ценой, дефицитом, обязанностью или отсутствием альтернатив
example_pasta.interpretation: A persistently high MRS supports the everyday claim 'I love pasta' as durable preference rather than novelty or convenience.

mapping.repeat_choice: recurrent free choice to remain engaged with the same person across changing contexts
mapping.satiation_resistance: familiarity does not automatically collapse significance into indifference or contempt
mapping.displacement_resistance: new alternatives do not mechanically erase the focal person's particular significance
mapping.temporal_persistence: the preference survives ordinary changes in mood, novelty and circumstance
mapping.return_after_pause: distance or temporary absence does not necessarily erase voluntary significance

human_relationship_application.critical_rule: HIGH_MRS cannot override a refusal, boundary, breakup, safety concern or another person's autonomy.
human_relationship_application.semantic_rule: For people, MRS measures persistence of one person's selective preference; it does not certify reciprocity, compatibility, healthy relationship quality or the other person's feelings.

janus_gate.name: LOVE_MRS_GATE
janus_gate.pass: MRS >= 0.70 AND V >= 0.80 AND no hard parent gate is violated
janus_gate.strong_pass: MRS >= 0.85 AND V >= 0.90 AND observations span >= 3 time windows AND alternatives were genuinely available
janus_gate.hold: insufficient longitudinal observations OR confounders unresolved
janus_gate.fail: V < 0.50 OR repetition is primarily coerced/forced OR preference shows persistent negative saturation

integration.bridge: PARTICULAR_SIGNIFICANCE -> FREE_REPEATED_SELECTION -> SATIATION_TEST -> ALTERNATIVE_TEST -> TIME_TEST -> MRS -> DURABLE_SELECTIVE_ATTACHMENT_EVIDENCE
integration.seal: WHAT RETURNS FREELY WITHOUT BECOMING A CHAIN MAY BE MEASURED AS PERSISTENT SIGNIFICANCE.
